adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new per-destination loop does `else { const destinationCalendarCredentials = this.calendarCredentials.filter((c) => c.type === destination.integration); createdEvents = createdEvents.concat(await Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event)))); }` for every destination lacking `credentialId`. If multiple destinations in `event.destinationCalendar` share the same `integration` and have no `credentialId`, this branch runs multiple times and creates events in *all* matching organizer credentials each time, producing duplicate events. This is a behavioral/correctness issue introduced by the refactor from single `destinationCalendar` to an array and the added loop.
